messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up—ACME is creeping past their monthly credit plan, onboarding still 60% complete. Need a quick playbook for the upcoming customer ops sync. :alarm_clock:
joel_csm: On it. Do we have a fresh spend forecast and which features are driving the burn?
anya_fin: I ran a 30/60 day projection earlier, looks like dev + embeddings test harness spikes on Tues/Thurs. Rough numbers: current run-rate ~$12k, projected to hit $18k without throttles.
sam_engineer: Embeddings batching is the culprit — their dev team hasn't enabled prefix caching. We can suggest a quick SDK change: enable batching=auto + cacheTTL=300.
maria_cs: Can we give a one-pager with exact flags and expected % savings? Ops wants numbers for renewal convo.
sam_engineer: Yes. Quick estimate: batching + cache -> ~35% token cost reduction on inference-heavy routes. I'll draft a snippet:```js
// Node SDK example
client.configure({ batching: 'auto', kvCacheTTL: 300 })
```
joel_csm: Nice. Also propose a short trial of Dedicated reservations — predictable unit price might make their finance team happier. Any uplift numbers vs hosted?
anya_fin: If they commit monthly reserved capacity for their peak, we can shave ~22% off per-token in our model mix. I'll run a commit vs pay-as-you-go calc and attach to the deck.
liz_support: FYI ACME raised a billing alert earlier today — billing-bot posted it. They were confused about a daily test harness delta. I clarified the ingestion timestamps and told them we'll review quotas.
billing-bot: [alert] account=ACME | threshold=90% of monthly credits | current=93% | action=notify-cs-team :bell:
maria_cs: Thanks @billing-bot and @liz_support. Let's add a temporary soft cap for their sandbox env and an automated mute for dev spikes. Can support help toggle?
liz_support: I can toggle sandbox cap to 50% of total credits and whitelist their staging IPs. Will do after Joel confirms.
joel_csm: Confirmed. Also scheduling a 20-min enablement with their infra lead tomorrow to go over config + cost dashboard. I'll include the commit calc and the SDK snippet.
anya_fin: Adding a one-slide forecast that shows current, conservative, and optimized paths (+percent savings). Will mark renewal risk as "watch" not urgent if they accept enablement + soft cap.
maria_cs: Perfect. Last item — capture feedback: ask them which endpoints they expect to scale and whether evals flagged regressions. We need that for Redwood Optimize recommendations.
sam_engineer: I'll prepare a short checklist for the call: routes, sequence lengths, peak qps, eval prompts.
maria_cs: Great. Action items: sam -> SDK snippet + checklist; anya -> commit vs PAYG calc + slide; liz -> toggle sandbox cap; joel -> run enablement + meeting notes. I'll send calendar invites. :white_check_mark:
liz_support: Done — sandbox cap toggled and I left a note in their tenant logs.
joel_csm: Invite sent for 10:00am PT tomorrow. Agenda in calendar description.
anya_fin: Uploaded draft slide to the shared QBR folder: https://redwood.workspaces/ACME/cost-forecast-draft (please review) :chart_with_upwards_trend:
maria_cs: Reviewing now. If everyone is good we'll flag this as "cost mitigation in progress" ahead of renewal. Thanks team.
